parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, archetype, archetype_traits, adversary, brand_goal, tone_of_voice, writing_guide,
  COALESCE(planning_horizon_weeks, 4) AS planning_horizon_weeks,
  COALESCE(posts_per_week, 1) AS posts_per_week,
  phases
FROM clients
WHERE (NULLIF($1, '') IS NULL OR id = $1)
ORDER BY name ASC

SELECT DATE(cycle_week) AS cycle_week, status FROM themes
WHERE client_id = $1
  AND COALESCE(status, 'proposed') NOT IN ('deleted')
  AND cycle_week >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
ORDER BY cycle_week ASC

SELECT a.headline, s.phase_key, s.theme,
  (COALESCE(a.interaction_likes, 0) + COALESCE(a.interaction_comments, 0)) AS engagement
FROM articles a
JOIN content_slots s ON s.id = a.slot_id
WHERE s.client_id = $1
  AND a.status IN ('published', 'archived')
ORDER BY engagement DESC
LIMIT 8

SELECT title, url, category, source_kind, description, trello_board_id, last_checked_at
FROM sources
WHERE client_id = $1 AND COALESCE(active, 1) = 1
ORDER BY last_checked_at DESC, title ASC
LIMIT 20

INSERT INTO themes (id, client_id, cycle_week, phase_key, title, motivation, rationale, source_article_url, status, feedback)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, 'proposed', 'none')

SELECT t.id AS theme_id, t.client_id, t.title, DATE(t.cycle_week) AS cycle_week
FROM themes t
WHERE t.client_id = $1
  AND COALESCE(t.status, 'proposed') IN ('proposed', 'draft', 'submitted')
  AND DATE(t.cycle_week) <= CURDATE()
ORDER BY t.cycle_week ASC

SELECT s.id AS slot_id, s.client_id
FROM content_slots s
INNER JOIN themes t ON t.id = s.theme_id
WHERE s.client_id = $1
  AND COALESCE(s.status, '') IN ('themed', 'research_done')
  AND COALESCE(s.origin, 'theme') <> 'fastlane'
  AND DATE(t.cycle_week) <= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM articles a
    WHERE a.slot_id = s.id
      AND COALESCE(a.status, '') NOT IN ('deleted')
  )
ORDER BY t.cycle_week ASC
